registration.title: Your next patient starts here.
registration.introduction: Apply once, verify your professional details, and prepare to issue prescriptions during in-person visits.

help.details: Tell us about you and your clinic. Enter the Arabic and English details yourself, exactly as you want them to appear on prescriptions.
help.account: Verify your phone and email to secure your application. This step saves your progress; it does not submit your application.
help.documents: Add clear images with all edges visible. You can take a photo or upload an existing image, one document at a time.
help.review: Take a moment to check your details and images. Your application goes to the Owner only when you submit it.

registration.privateHelp: Your documents are private. Only you can access your draft; authorized Owners review your submitted evidence.
registration.draftExpiry: Your private draft is available until {{date}}.
registration.schoolHelp: Enter the institution as recorded on your certificate. An entered name does not establish verification.
registration.passwordHelp: Use a strong, unique password. Avoid your name, phone number, and common passwords.
registration.verificationHelp: Phone verification comes first, then email verification. Need a new code? Restart verification below.
registration.retention: Approved doctors’ images are retained privately for the account lifetime. Rejected application images are erased under our rejection policy.
registration.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MiB per image

documentHint.graduation: Include the full certificate and readable institution details.
documentHint.id_front: Keep the photograph and printed details clear.
documentHint.id_back: Include the full back of your national ID.
documentHint.passport: Include only the identity page, with all edges visible.
documentHint.syndicate: Keep your name and registration details readable.
documentHint.practice_license: Optional: include the full licence document.

registration.captureHelp: Line up the document inside the guide. Check lighting and legibility before using the photo. The guide helps framing; it does not verify authenticity.
registration.cameraUnavailable: We could not open your camera. Allow camera access in your browser, or upload an existing image instead.
registration.imageType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
registration.imageSize: Choose a non-empty image up to 10 MiB.
registration.previewError: Could not load the private image.
registration.licenceNumberHelp: If the number is missing or unclear in the image, you may type it here. Neither the image nor this number is required.
registration.documentsMissing: Add all required document images before continuing.
registration.finalNotice: Check carefully: submitted identity and qualification details become read-only. Approval is a separate Owner decision.
registration.retrySubmission: If the result is uncertain, submit again to recover the same application. You will not create a second submission.
registration.submittedBody: Your application is now waiting for Owner review. You can sign in to check its status. Prescribing becomes available after approval and normal authenticator sign-in.
registration.resumeHelp: Enter the phone and password used for your application. Your saved draft lasts seven days after verification.
registration.remembered: Don’t worry! We saved your progress from {{ago}}.
registration.restoreError: We could not check for a saved draft. You can retry by choosing Resume application.
registration.leaveUnsaved: Leave this application? Entries not yet saved to your private draft will be lost.

sms: Enter the code sent to your phone
emailCode: Enter the code sent to your email
enroll: Add this secret to your authenticator, then enter its six-digit code.
submitted: Application submitted. Sign in to check its status.
manualPatient: No customer found. Enter the patient’s details.
confirmPatient: I have confirmed the intended patient and phone number.
letterheadDescription: Your letterhead is captured when a prescription is issued.
error: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
unsure: The result is uncertain. Retry with the same action reference to recover its outcome.
logoTypes: PNG or JPEG · up to 2 MiB · 16–2000 px per side
noDraftSave: Your unfinished prescription is kept in this open page.

dose.complete: Complete the dose and schedule to preview instructions.

logoLoadError: Could not load the saved clinic logo. Reload this page to retry.
headerHelp: Optional display text for your letterhead. Enter names in each language; leave blank to use registered details. No automatic translation.
